Talent0_2Ability.name: Kalavinka
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects:
When equipping two Assault Weapons, both weapons share Range.
After actively attacking with any Assault Weapon, can move an extra <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Kalavinka
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When equipping two Assault Weapons, both weapons share Range and <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>.
After actively attacking with any Assault Weapon, can move an extra <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.
Machine Gun, Shotgun, and Flamethrower <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> increased by <color=#F74848>1</color> tile.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

201609.name: Crimson Blitz
201609.describe: Uses a Machine Gun, Shotgun, or Flamethrower to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3</color>x DMG.

201604.name: Swift Steps
201604.describe:
Can be activated when Legs are undestroyed. Selects <color=#F74848>1</color> empty tile within range and jumps to the selected tile. The selectable range is equal to current Movement. Triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> afterward. Cannot move before attacking.
When destroying a target, skill cooldown is additionally reduced by <color=#F74848>1</color>.

201605.name: Shadow Raid
201605.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat and hitting <color=#F74848>12</color> times or more, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-20%</color> when retaliated against by the target.

201606.name: Heartpiercing Duo
201606.describe: Uses two Assault Weapons to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.75</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. After combat, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

201607.name: Infinite Hunt
201607.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if the target cannot retaliate, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2016503>[Dual Gun Efficiency]</buf> after combat. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

201608.name: Crimson Rondo
201608.describe: Uses two Assault Weapons to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.85</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. After combat, if equipped with a Shotgun, Machine Gun, or Flamethrower, gains <buf ID=2016085>[Rondo - Shotgun]</buf>, <buf ID=2016087>[Rondo - Machine Gun]</buf>, or <buf ID=2016080>[Rondo - Flamethrower]</buf> respectively, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200031.name: Perfect Position 1
200031.SpecificEffects: Unlock the Assault Weapon's <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> ability. When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2
200034.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200035.name: Perfect Position 3
200035.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200036.name: Perfect Position 4
200036.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

201641.name: Hawk Rush 1
201641.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a single-handed Assault Weapon, after combat gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2016503>[Dual Gun Efficiency]</buf>. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

201644.name: Hawk Rush 2
201644.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=2016410>[Hawk Rush 1]</buf> can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per type of single-handed Assault Weapon each turn.

201645.name: Hawk Rush 3
201645.SpecificEffects: When attacking with two Assault Weapons, gains <buf ID=2016452>[Hawk Rush]</buf> before combat. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>4</color> times.

201646.name: Hawk Rush 4
201646.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with two Assault Weapons, both weapons can trigger <buf ID=2016410>[Hawk Rush 1]</buf> to gain <buf ID=2016503>[Dual Gun Efficiency]</buf>.
